scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:api-production: pnpm run check:generated-api && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-production-schema-columns && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run check-publish-schema-safety && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run check:generated-api && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
